review_summary: Independently read both proposed facts' complete canonical citation sets and all upstream contradiction evidence. Both factual corrections agree with functionality.md and the rendered view. Inherit supported retained research unchanged; no overrides required.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical ItemStateTable defines its first member as anim_id. The projectile supplies one row with animation ID 0 and three callbacks, while its initializer separately requests motion state index 0. This corrects a factual conflation without asserting compiled layout.

The canonical attribute definition contains six floats and two ints. Both branches use hitbox 0; x14 and x18 are passed as damage to a helper that writes hitbox damage and may adjust it using owner state. The lifetime helper independently confirms the lifetime roles. The proposal and functionality document agree.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of the three .sdata claims: inspected rotation calls establish source dependencies but cannot establish diagnostic-string contents, filename spelling, padding or compiled section attribution.

Accept deferral of the three .sdata2 claims: zero initialization, one-unit decrement and the <=0 expiration threshold are visible, but constant-pool placement, encoding and extent require compiled evidence. The timer is not clamped to zero.

Accept deferral of both gameplay-mapping claims: forwarding cmd_vars[1] and selecting opaque attributes by zero/nonzero do not establish ordinary versus forward-smash mapping or literal 8/12 damage. The damage helper also permits owner-dependent adjustment.
Accept superseding the state-identifier interpretation with proposal fact 0: animation ID and motion-state index are distinct despite both being zero here.
Accept superseding the hitbox-selector interpretation with proposal fact 1: the two integer attributes provide alternative damage inputs to the same hitbox, not different hitbox selections.
